items.text: Hello, everyone. Here are the changes in this update.
Patch download size 7 GB
Before Updating on PC

Third-party mods. Some third-party mods may be incompatible with this update. If you have mods installed, we recommend removing them before updating. If Steam shows a much larger download than expected, or if you encounter issues after updating, check for any remaining mod files. Remove them, then retry the update or relaunch the game.

Shader cache. If you experience crashes or stuttering after updating, try clearing your shader cache. In your Steam Library, right-click Phantom Blade Zero and select Manage → Browse Local Files. Open PBZ\\ProjectPBZ\\Saved\\Cache and delete the files inside. Shaders will recompile automatically the next time you launch the game.: New Features

Added a Combat Assist section in Settings and an Automatic Strong Camera Assist option. With this option turned off, strong camera assistance applies only while you are attacking an enemy. At other times, the camera makes only minor adjustments.

\PC: Added Mouse Lock-On Target Switching Sensitivity, which lets you adjust how sensitive target switching is when using the mouse while locked on. Set it to 0 to disable mouse-based target switching.: Improvements and Adjustments
Reduced video memory and system memory usage, with the most noticeable improvements in cutscenes and snowy areas.
Improved performance in certain areas and boss fights, and reduced stuttering caused by certain visual effects.
Improved how the game automatically locks on to targets during combat.
Improved movement over small rocks, low steps, and gentle slopes, reducing instances where movement could hitch or be blocked.
Updated the controls and effects for the Soft Snake Sword. Hold Execute to perform Sword Blossom Shield. We also increased the invulnerability window for sidesteps in Guard Stance.
Updated certain weapon and skill descriptions, and corrected issues with some UI elements, icons, and localized text.: Bug Fixes: Graphics and Audio
\PC: Fixed an issue where bright square artifacts could appear in volumetric clouds on AMD Radeon RX 9000 Series graphics cards with certain driver versions.
Fixed playback issues in some cutscenes, as well as flickering and light leaks in some areas.
Fixed visual issues that could cause characters’ sleeves and fingers to appear stretched when viewed from farther away.
Fixed issues where certain voice lines, sound effects, and background music were missing or played incorrectly. Also adjusted the volume of some dialogue and ambient sounds.: Combat and Stats
Fixed an issue where some enemies could remain invisible while still being able to move and attack after players used a bell to reset them.
Fixed an issue where bosses could stop acting during combat under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue where resistance to Chill did not work correctly.
Fixed an issue that could prevent consecutive dodges while using certain weapons.
Fixed an issue where certain unblockable attacks from the Blizzard Blademaster could deal unintended damage.
Fixed an issue where raising Bastion after upgrading it to level 25 could fail to restore Sha-Chi to full.

Fixed an issue where Earthshaking Slam, a skill for the War Wagon Phantom Edge, could hit repeatedly and incorrectly stack damage, potentially defeating most enemies in one use. The skill is designed to deal damage once per use, with no damage stacking from repeated hits.

Fixed an issue where the Dance Fan accessory’s damage bonus stayed active and applied to all skills. The bonus could stack and distort damage calculations across combat. By design, it applies once per use to eligible skills that move the character a single time.

Fixed an issue where the Nuo Mask accessory also reduced the Remnant Spark cost of Artifice-type Phantom Edges, allowing players to use affected Phantom Edges repeatedly at no cost. The reduction is intended to apply only to Summon-type Phantom Edges.

Fixed an issue where using Fatal Execution, an advanced skill unlocked through Sanguine Reach, with any two-handed weapon could deal an incorrect amount of stagger damage and cause enemies to stagger every time.
Fixed several other combat issues involving executions, revival, boss abilities, and weapon and accessory effects.: Progression, Quests, and Achievements

Fixed issues that could block progression or prevent quest rewards from being granted. This includes cases where players could get stuck after interacting with a bell or opening a chest immediately after defeating a boss.

Fixed an issue where handing over certain books during the story could prevent players from reaching 100% item collection. The missing items will be restored automatically when players load the game after updating.

\PC: Fixed an issue where Defy Destiny could fail to unlock even after players earned every other achievement. Players who already meet the requirements will unlock it automatically the next time they launch the game after updating.
Fixed several areas where characters could get stuck or fall unexpectedly.
Fixed an issue that could block progression in Bloodline Awakening.

Updated the completion conditions for The Undying Heroic Spirit. The quest can now be completed even if players fail to defeat the suffering members of the Mandate within the time limit. Players can still earn the corresponding Memory Flower by defeating them within the time limit.
Fixed an issue where interacting with A-Ping and her husband in the Village of Lu could fail to trigger a response, preventing players from obtaining a Sha-Chi Amber Shard.
Fixed an issue where a Blackstone Shard could fail to drop in the Backstreet.
Fixed an issue where the mechanism-operated door in Leng Tu’s Study at Mirage Estate could close again after the area reloaded.
Fixed an issue in New Game+ that prevented players from completing the The Sword and the Way objective to use Bronze Essence to Soul Temper the Tianxuan Bronze Sword.

Fixed an issue that could prevent Honor Among Thieves from triggering in New Game+.: Thank you for continuing to share your feedback. We’ll keep listening and improving the game. To report an issue or share a suggestion, please visit https://pbz.s-game.com/support.
[p align="justify"]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. This patch introduces new audio and control options, along with performance improvements, combat adjustments, and bug fixes.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]● Added “Hit Sound Intensity” and “Hit Impact Sound Intensity” options to the audio settings.
[p align="justify"]● \PC: Added support for remapping “Interact / Talk” for both keyboard and controller.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]● Improved performance in certain areas.
[p align="justify"]● Adjusted the combat behavior of certain bosses and enemies, along with the functionality of certain environmental mechanisms.
[p align="justify"]● Reduced the frequency of grab attacks used by Hua, Deadly Betrothed on Wayfarer and Pathbreaker difficulties. Other difficulty settings are unaffected.
[p align="justify"]● Improved weapon hit feedback and adjusted the volume of certain sound effects and dialogue.
[p align="justify"]● Updated weapon descriptions, certain skill descriptions, and controller button icons.

[p align="justify"]● \PC: Updated the shader compilation process to significantly reduce startup times. Ray tracing shaders will no longer be compiled by default at startup. Players who previously had Ray Tracing disabled will need to recompile shaders on their first launch after installing this patch. This is a one-time process and should take only a short time. Players who previously had Ray Tracing enabled can start playing without recompiling shaders. If you enable Ray Tracing in the settings, the required ray tracing shaders will be compiled separately the next time you restart the game.
[p align="justify"]● \PC: Reduced stuttering that could occur when using a controller connected via Bluetooth.
[p align="justify"]● \PC: NVIDIA Reflex now works when set to “Auto” with V-Sync enabled.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]● Fixed issues that could prevent progression under certain conditions.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed environmental issues that could cause the player character to become stuck.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed various issues with cutscenes and visuals.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed several combat-related issues.
[p align="justify"]● Fixed an issue that caused character hair to render incorrectly on certain AMD graphics cards with specific driver versions.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]We will continue to monitor your feedback and improve the game experience. To report an issue or share your feedback, please visit our official support page.
[p align="justify"]
Please note the following common issues related to this update:
Some third-party mods are not compatible with this update and may cause issues. If you encounter problems after updating, please remove any installed mods.

If you experience crashes or stuttering after updating, please clear the game’s shader cache and relaunch the game. Shaders will then be quickly recompiled. Cache file location: right-click Phantom Blade Zero in your Steam Library, select Manage → Browse local files, then go to the PBZ\\ProjectPBZ\\Saved\\Cache folder and delete the files inside.
[p align="justify"]S-GAME
